bagPolicy.summary: Providence Park enforces a clear bag policy for events. Clear bags up to 14"x14"x6" are allowed, while non-clear clutches must not exceed 4.5"x7.5".
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Fans are encouraged to arrive early and park outside the parade zone due to road closures and parking restrictions starting at 2pm. Public transit is recommended as matchday tickets can be used as TriMet fare.

rideshare.note: For Timbers and Thorns matches, Lyft has designated pickup and drop-off spots at the corner of SW Alder and 19th, on SW Salmon in front of Lincoln High School, and at SW Morrison and 20th Place. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

concessions.note: Providence Park offers a remarkable food and beverage experience with gameday classics and unique culinary creations, highlighting local and regional flavors. Park Provisions is the official concessionaire, providing opportunities for non-profit fundraising.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair and companion seats can be bought in advance through SeatGeek at 888-983-1783, and you can arrange a wheelchair escort by calling 503.553.5550. Gates A through F all have ADA entrances, only service dogs are allowed, and assisted listening is available. KultureCity sensory bags can be checked out at the Guest Services Center near section 104 on matchdays.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed at almost all events at Providence Park, including Timbers and Thorns games.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Providence Park box office is next to Gate D on the KeyBank Plaza, at the corner of SW 18th Avenue and SW Morrison.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Gates A through F all have ADA accessible entrances, with a sidewalk ramp outside Gates A and B. For Timbers and Thorns matches, all gates open 90 minutes before kickoff. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
